import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.PriorityQueue;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    static class Pair {
        int first, second;

        public Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static int Inf = 1000000000;
    static int Maxn = 11;
    static int MaxN = 205;
    static int Maxd = 4;
    static int[] dy = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dx = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] a = new char[Maxn][Maxn];
    static char[][] b = new char[Maxn][Maxn];
    static int br, bc;
    static int[][] bum = new int[Maxn][Maxn];
    static int[][] dist = new int[Maxn][Maxn];
    static boolean[][] pos = new boolean[Maxn][Maxn];
    static int N;
    static int[][] R = new int[MaxN][MaxN];
    static int[] F = new int[MaxN];
    static int[] P = new int[MaxN];
    static int res;

    static void BFS1() {
        for (int i = 0; i < Maxn; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < Maxn; j++) {
                bum[i][j] = t;
            }
        }
        bum[br][bc] = 0;
        ArrayDeque<Pair> Q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Q.add(new Pair(br, bc));
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair v = Q.poll();
            int d = bum[v.first][v.second];
            for (int i = 0; i < Maxd; i++) {
                Pair u = new Pair(v.first + dy[i], v.second + dx[i]);
                if (0 <= u.first && u.first < n && 0 <= u.second && u.second < n && a[u.first][u.second] != 'Y' && d + 1 < bum[u.first][u.second]) {
                    bum[u.first][u.second] = d + 1;
                    Q.add(u);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void BFS2(int sr, int sc) {
        for (int i = 0; i < Maxn; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < Maxn; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = Inf;
                pos[i][j] = false;
            }
        }
        dist[sr][sc] = 0;
        pos[sr][sc] = true;
        ArrayDeque<Pair> Q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Q.add(new Pair(sr, sc));
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair v = Q.poll();
            int d = dist[v.first][v.second];
            pos[v.first][v.second] = d <= bum[v.first][v.second];
            if (d >= bum[v.first][v.second]) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < Maxd; i++) {
                Pair u = new Pair(v.first + dy[i], v.second + dx[i]);
                if (0 <= u.first && u.first < n && 0 <= u.second && u.second < n && a[u.first][u.second] != 'Y' && d + 1 < dist[u.first][u.second]) {
                    dist[u.first][u.second] = d + 1;
                    Q.add(u);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void BFS(int sr, int sc, int[][] dist, int Inf) {
        for (int i = 0; i < Maxn; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < Maxn; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = Inf;
            }
        }
        dist[sr][sc] = 0;
        ArrayDeque<Pair> Q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Q.add(new Pair(sr, sc));
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair v = Q.poll();
            int d = dist[v.first][v.second];
            for (int i = 0; i < Maxd; i++) {
                Pair u = new Pair(v.first + dy[i], v.second + dx[i]);
                if (0 <= u.first && u.first < n && 0 <= u.second && u.second < n && a[u.first][u.second] != 'Y' && d + 1 < dist[u.first][u.second]) {
                    dist[u.first][u.second] = d + 1;
                    Q.add(u);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int getFlow() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            F[i] = 0;
        }
        F[0] = Inf;
        PriorityQueue<Pair> Q = new PriorityQueue<>((o1, o2) -> o2.first - o1.first);
        Q.add(new Pair(Inf, 0));
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair v = Q.poll();
            int f = v.first;
            int u = v.second;
            if (F[u] != f) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < R[u].length; i++) {
                int w = R[u][i];
                if (min(f, R[u][w]) > F[w]) {
                    F[w] = min(f, R[u][w]);
                    P[w] = u;
                    Q.add(new Pair(F[w], w));
                }
            }
        }
        int v = N - 1;
        if (F[v] == 0) return 0;
        int res = F[v];
        while (v != 0) {
            int u = P[v];
            R[u][v] -= res;
            R[v][u] += res;
            v = u;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
                    s = br.readLine();
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        b[i][k] = s.charAt(k);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        BFS1();
        N = 2 * n * n + 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] >= '1' && a[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int v = i * n + j + 1;
                    R[0][v] = a[i][j] - '0';
                    R[v][0] = 0;
                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
                        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                            if (pos[i2][j2] && b[i2][j2] >= '1' && b[i2][j2] <= '9') {
                                int u = n * n + i2 * n + j2 + 1;
                                R[v][u] = Inf;
                                R[u][v] = 0;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (b[i][j] >= '1' && b[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int u = n * n + i * n + j + 1;
                    R[u][N - 1] = b[i][j] - '0';
                    R[N - 1][u] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        int f;
        while ((f = getFlow()) != 0) {
            res += f;
        }
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        pw.println(res);
        pw.close();
    }
